resolution.method: No record in sf-eas-addresses for 1132 04TH ST. The record spells the street out as FOURTH; EAS holds the numbered streets as zero-padded ordinals, so this is 04TH.
resolution.note: The address does not exist today, so there is no page it can go on. The nearest surviving numbers on the street are 1115, 1120, 1125, 1130, 1135, 1145. Per "The evidence bar" in research/AGENTS.md this is a street-hub fact: a dated record of a building at a number the city no longer has.
